learning.normalization_rule: Original W1 float64 mean/std; std floor0.05; frozen float32 buffers; no refit

outcomes.walking: 1000 actual controls, no fall, mean absolute x-velocity error from1.5 <=0.3
outcomes.confirmation: same >=2 of3 streams gain >=2 walking over each parent/uniform/shuffled; no walking/full-survival regression in any stream, repeatedconfirmation
outcomes.individual_competence: at least15/16 walking on both fresh panels

diagnostics.reuse_gate: Stop/version before launch unless completed R1 audit and exact actor/input/batch bindings pass. No replacement forwards or hidden budget fallback.
diagnostics.own_corpus_batches: Four source-episode-aligned batches of exactly 1000 rows per actor/stream.
diagnostics.fitting_MSE_reduction: Saved float32 predictions minus float32 training targets, converted to float64 for squared residual reductions. Original native-target sum-six disagreement is retained separately, not divided by six as an exact substitute.

independent_audit.scope: Recompute all NEW nontraining predictions; bind 30000 reused incoming source/historical rows through completed R1 audit and exact actor/input/batch bytes. No assay/old-forward replay or training/native rerun.

existing_array_stream_storage.512_byte_journal_limit_compatibility: Existing BinaryEvidenceMeter constructor requires max_event_bytes >=2048. A candidate-local pre-write compact-schema/append guard must enforce actual <=512-byte frequent lines without changing old defaults or format; passing512 alone is invalid.

config.stopping: Any source/replay/continuation/seed/runtime/capacity/accounting/numerical/provenance/budget failure stops; no retries, parent refits, reacquisition, gate relaxation, redraws or follow-ups. Complete all12000assays then stop allfits if any treatmentf32constant or identicalshuffled. Baselines are a paid prerequisite included in the same6-hourworker/physicsbudget, and gate every substitution and fit.

historical_review_census_binding.scope: Immutable pre-authorization review; launch_enabled/status/null prerequisite fields there describe its historical review state.

accounting_notes.raw_cost: sum native costs less native fall terminal
accounting_notes.native_cost: sum actual native costs including the terminal once
accounting_notes.complete_cost: native_cost plus5 per missing control within requestedh afterfall
accounting_notes.fitting_audit: Recompute residual losses from saved actual f32 forward tapes; no training/gradient rerun. Gradient norms are worker-recorded, finite/hash-bound, not independently rederived.
accounting_notes.transfer_reservations: One input deployment and one compact result collection, each at most128MiB; no bulk raw/checkpoint transfer.
accounting_notes.preparation_input_reads: 512MiB combined local metadata, selected source extraction and conservative preflight input-read upper; code/shared-library import IO remains engineering overhead.

diagnostics.scope: C1 fixed-suffix consequence-weighted fitting; walking and fitting are separate. Inspection does not independently audit science.
